The '''''Starpoint''''' was an [[Endurance-class fleet carrier|''Endurance''-class fleet carrier]] of the [[New Republic Fifth Fleet|New Republic Fifth Battle Group]], and was [[Commodore/Legends|Commodore]] [[Poqua]]'s flagship.
